title: A preview pane: the app a session runs, beside the chat
request: The owner's goal: Claude Code's and Codex's capabilities; the UI review named the preview pane as the first gap.
plan: a Preview tab in the drawer
local addresses only, allowed by the page's policy
the address suggested from the conversation

decisions.why: the app's page policy stays closed to other sites; a preview is of the person's own running app

decisions.decision: DCLab Code's own address is refused
decisions.why: the app inside itself would share its origin and its token

change: dclab-code web/index.html (the tab), web/app.js (renderPreview, previewSuggestion, palette item), web/style.css, server/app.js (frame-src for local addresses), tests/page.test.js, docs.

findings.defect: the preview stayed blank in the running test app
findings.cause: the running app predated the new frame-src policy, and DCLab's own page refuses to be framed
findings.fix: restart the app; the pane's note says a page that refuses framing stays blank
findings.test: Chromium page test frames a local page

outcome: The person sees the app a session runs beside the chat.
lessons: A new frame needs the page's own policy to allow it: check the headers before the markup.
risks: the agent cannot see or click the preview yet
